prompt:
FORMAT: Landscape 3:2 illustration (1536x1024) for the home hero of a Korean fortune-telling website. Opaque full-bleed background.
STYLE: Soft storybook gouache-and-watercolor illustration, clean rounded shapes, gentle paper grain, warm dusk lighting, polished and cozy, cute but not childish. Same rendering style and character design as the attached reference image.
CHARACTER (must match the attached reference exactly): Yeoni, a small chubby pink flower-piglet. Round pink face, short round snout, sparkling dark-brown eyes, a pink lotus flower worn on one side of her head, a purple scarf around her neck, tiny hooves, a warm and kind smile. Keep her proportions, colors and outfit identical to the reference.
SCENE: Yeoni sits on a low round stone in a moonlit fortune garden at early evening, welcoming the viewer with a gentle wave. Around her: peonies and lotus blossoms, a small lotus pond, soft lilac sky with a pale crescent moon, a few floating golden firefly lights, and subtle fortune motifs (two face-down tarot cards with plain patterned backs resting on the stone, a small rolled star-chart scroll). Calm, inviting, uncluttered.
COMPOSITION: Yeoni centered horizontally, full body visible, about 45% of the image height. Her entire head and body must stay inside the central horizontal band between 25% and 75% of the image height and inside the central 60% of the width, so the image can be center-cropped to a wide 16:7 strip or to a 4:3 frame without cutting her. Top edge is quiet sky, bottom edge is quiet grass and petals; no important detail near any edge.
PALETTE: cream #FFF9F4, blush pink #F8E4EA, deep rose #B53660 accents, plum #402A38 for darkest line details, muted gold #8A6A2E highlights, two lilac tones #E9E0F5 and #B9A6D9.
NO_TEXT: absolutely no text, letters, numbers, runes, logos, watermarks, signatures, frames or UI elements anywhere in the image.
note: codex exec 가 stdin 대기로 15분 정지 — 이미지 호출 전 중지. 상한 계산에서 제외.
